summary: Session 16 changed no game code (journal only); the suite passes 10/10. I only reviewed the side-panels screenshot and did not run new interactive play, so the issues below are what is visible there and they are already known to the author.

failures.actual: Pinchy and Marshmallow labels are stacked close together. The label at the right edge shows only the tail of 'Snoop' and is clipped by the viewport edge and the cloud-shaped object.

failures.what: Activity panel shows raw agent text
failures.steps: Look at the Sprout panel at the top right.
failures.actual: The panel shows raw quoted agent output, including backticked file paths such as `world/outbox/20261122-174926-032.json` and phrases like 'it says I'm ignoring the ended (end_turn) after 0.7 min, 6 tool calls'.
